answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring independent proof bundles before granting influence. Each identity posts collateral, completes unpredictable tasks, and gathers attestations from reviewers chosen outside its social cluster. An ivory receipt records each verified contribution, while a knoll of reputation grows only after repeated agreement across time. Reward claims move through a saffron queue with rate limits; audits slash copied histories and make mass fabrication costly.
